OPT-1 calculated review candidate from the bound master (104 base
fittings, 47 controlled groups). Four selected 2700 K curtain
strips bring the review schedule to 108 fittings / 51 circuits;
no new knobs or photometry credit. Kitchen task option K-2 is
homeowner-selected for review: it adds the sink-end linear KIT-T4
and lowers KIT-T1 output. Generic-optics analytic estimates, not
measured or manufacturer-validated; no photometry is shown on
this sheet. Not construction-released; product, driver, dimmer
and site-fit holds remain open. Each bathroom face-light pair has
its own knob (HD-17). Pooja fittings remain count/load allowances
only, with inherited positions held (H-POOJA-GEOMETRY); no
HEIGHTS (HD-11, all unmeasured): the 11 ft floor-to-floor (3.353
m) and ~9 in (0.229 m) band drop are homeowner-stated; the band
underside 2.959 m and slab underside 3.188 m are derived from
them (5 in slab and 1.5 in finish assumed). The raised centre is
a separate gypsum/POP panel below the slab (HD-14); its level and
cavity depth are unmeasured, and 3.19 m is only the
slab-underside reference plane. Bathrooms 2.40 m, utility 2.95 m,
lobby and balcony levels were not provided (placeholders). Window
and door heads are assumptions. Nothing is as-built.
Compass: approximate homeowner north, recorded in the master
face NORTH. Cardinal directions only — true bearing and magnetic
Raised centre (HD-14): a separate gypsum/POP panel below the
slab. The homeowner confirms space will be provided for the
aluminium profile/track and wiring; the clear cavity depth, the
panel level and the driver location are unmeasured. LIV-X1/X2,
DIN-X1 and DIN-L1 need a conditional product-fit and access check
(H-CENTRE-RECESS). No slab chase or structural cutting is
authorised. H-HALL-BEAM — beam soffit unmeasured for DIN-H2/H3
and FW-T1. Band void is 228.6 mm gross (~216 mm net).
MASTER: bed position is a held test centreline (H-MBR-BED); the
tenant bed is not supplied. The W03 curtain pocket is held
(H-MBR-W03: pocket and loft interface unresolved; offsets
Curtains (HD-14): living, master and children’s rooms carry TWO
layers (sheer + blackout) on ceiling-mounted tracks concealed in
recessed pockets, so each pocket needs two tracks. Track spacing,
bracket dimensions, stack and clear pocket width/depth are
unverified; pocket outlines here are indicative only.
S1 MODEL CLASH: assumed MBR-S and CBR strip returns each extend
about 0.30 m beyond a modeled room corner. Lines are clipped for
display only. Measure pocket ends and coordinate site fit; do not
extend or cut from the model.
CHILDREN’S ROOM: CBR-H1 to H6 and the curtain strip are selected
for review. The cove is retained; the outward-shifted LINE paths
and cove remain held and unlit. The fan is shown at the
unmeasured proposed cove centre. Verify fan sweep, clearances,
Dining + living share one raised centre panel. The kitchen
ceiling is one flat level at band height. Black-painted grooves
are drawn only where the master records them (master and
Pooja niche PN1: already built; its east-wall relationship is
notation, but dimensions and position remain homeowner estimates,
not site measurements (OI-POOJA-01). The homeowner reports a
reinforced slab extension beyond the 9-inch wall, top to bottom
through the building. Extension geometry and load capacity are
unverified: only the estimated front outline is drawn, not a
physical back or structural section. No cutting or structural
change is requested or approved. LIV-P1 / LIV-P2 are count/load
allowances only; inherited positions are held (H-POOJA-GEOMETRY).
Fan points and lofts are assumed; curtain-pocket sizes are
indicative only (HD-14). Switch-plate zones are not drawn: the
master holds none (only the R05 latch-side strip appears on the
